tagline: Flat-share app: availability, chores, menu, money and bill scanning for one flat of six. Live at https://wecohabit.vercel.app

sections.title: Phase 1: Foundation
sections.summary: Next.js + Tailwind + Supabase setup, migrations, RLS, flat creation and invite link, design tokens, bottom nav shell.

sections.title: Phase 2: Members and availability
sections.summary: Members screen, cook and maid as no-login members, away periods, calendar, isPresent with tests.

sections.title: Phase 3: Chores, menu, PWA (v1 launch)
sections.summary: Chore rotation, daily job, menu with computed headcount and No-cook days, Serwist install, Web Push.

sections.title: Phase 4: Money ledger and New split
sections.summary: Categories and split rules, expense ledger, expense detail with items and shares, New split with editable per-person shares.

sections.title: Phase 5: Bill scanning
sections.summary: Compress and upload, /api/scan with Gemini primary and Groq fallback, two-step review with item checkboxes, people chips and editable shares.

sections.title: Sign-in: Tenant's own accounts
sections.summary: Moved sign-in to username and password, then replaced Supabase Auth with Tenant's own accounts and sessions.

sections.title: Project log and test-case audit
sections.summary: Set up .project-log (status, requests, changelog, renderer, status page). Ran npm run check: typecheck, lint and 131/131 tests pass. All 13 SPEC §12 cases map to a passing test.

sections.title: First run fixes
sections.summary: Pushed pending migrations, fixed the secret key in .env.local, fixed the Date.now() prerender error after the own-auth change. Sign-up works; Today, Calendar, Money, Chores and Menu load signed in.

sections.title: Part-day away and breakfast
sections.summary: Morning / Afternoon / Night for a single day. Slots only affect meals (per-meal headcount and No cook); chores and money treat the person as home. Breakfast added to the menu. Migration pushed, Edge Functions redeployed, browser-checked at 375/768/1440.

sections.title: Deployed to Vercel
sections.summary: Live at https://tenant-plum.vercel.app. Vercel project linked to GitHub main, so every push deploys. Env vars set; all main pages checked signed in.

sections.title: Address: wecohabit.vercel.app
sections.summary: Production moved to wecohabit.vercel.app (free Vercel subdomain). Site URL updated and redeployed.

sections.title: Sample data
sections.summary: Filled C2 102 with sample data via npm run seed:sample: Madan, Karthik, Rishab, Kishore and Barani (logins with a shared sample password), cook Lakshmi and maid Selvi. Barani away 1 Sep – 30 Nov. 12 away periods, 5 chores with 62 duties since 7 Oct, 20 menu days (the flat's own Mon–Sat weekly menu, 26 Oct – 14 Nov), 24 expenses Sep–Nov (shares computed by the engine). Checked live at 375/768/1440 signed in as Madan.

sections.title: Faster pages and staying signed in
sections.summary: Functions moved from iad1 (US) to sin1, next to the Supabase database in Singapore. User, member and flat load in one parallel query; the chores week in one. Visited tabs are reused for 60 s. Sessions now last 180 days and renew on use. Live from India: full page 1.5–2.6 s → 0.6–0.75 s; first tap on a tab ~0.35 s; revisited tab ~0.05 s. Sign-in survives a browser restart.

sections.title: Members admin: flat code, join requests, remove members
sections.summary: A 6-character flat code (no look-alike characters) replaces the invite link. New people sign up, enter the code and wait; the admin accepts or declines in Settings (with a notice on Today). Admin can rename the cook or maid, switch them between cook and maid, and remove anyone but themselves: with history they are marked as left (bills kept), without history they are deleted. Old /join links go to onboarding. Also fixed: creating a flat bounced back to onboarding since the 60 s tab cache. End-to-end run on a production build: 22/22 checks pass. Re-run against the live site after deploy: 22/22 pass.

sections.title: Own-data permissions, chores banner, Barani back 20 Nov
sections.summary: Each flatmate changes only their own away days (plus the cook's and maid's leave), their own splits and their own duties; the admin can change anyone's. Someone else's away period opens read-only. Server actions and database functions enforce the same rules (lib/engine/permissions.ts). Chores banner now lists only full-day absences. Tapping an away flatmate on Today opens their away period. Barani's away now ends 19 Nov (back 20 Nov). E2E on a production build: 17/17, including a forged request that the server refuses. Re-run on the live site after deploy: 17/17.

sections.title: Flow audit (live site, phone size)
sections.summary: Walked every journey on the live site at 375 px: a new person (sign up, create flat, every empty tab, add chore, plan menu, add split, scan page, mark away) and an existing flatmate (Madan: all tabs, day view, rotation, menu day, bills, settings). Found 8 issues, ranked in open questions / next sections. Screenshots at 375 px only (this was an audit, not a UI change).

sections.title: Flow fixes from the audit
sections.summary: Sign-up goes straight to onboarding (no detour through Today) and a branded error page with one automatic retry replaces Next's bare one. Chore form no longer scrolls sideways; frequency options are one line (Daily / Weekly / Some days). Today states a decided no-cook day ("No cook tomorrow: ordering in") and cook alerts open that week's menu; Menu shows "Ordering in" on decided days. Away saves no longer wait for the leave alert (sent after the response, staff only): ~0.7–1.2 s instead of ~3.7 s. A part-day absence no longer shows as away in Settings. Cook's pay counts every cook employed that month (Lakshmi → Mary). Lakshmi marked as left on 5 Nov; Mary is the cook. E2E on a production build: 12 checks pass. Re-run on the live site after deploy: same 12 pass.

sections.title: First-run guidance and Menu at today
sections.summary: New "Get started" card on Today for the admin of a new flat: add flatmates, add the cook or maid, add a chore, plan this week's meals. Each step ticks itself off from real data and the card disappears when all four are done. Today's menu offers "Plan today's meals" to whoever plans. Menu starts at today on the current week, with earlier days folded under "Earlier this week"; the admin sees "You plan meals until you pick a menu owner" instead of being told to ask the admin. E2E on a production build: 15/15. Re-run on the live site: 15/15.

sections.title: Admin and notification gaps
sections.summary: The admin gets a push when someone asks to join (notify Edge Function, sent after the response). The admin can hand admin rights to another current flatmate (hand_over_admin, one transaction). "My meals" in Settings: each person picks meals they usually skip; meal headcounts leave them out. Found and fixed: the live Edge Functions had never started because their secrets were never uploaded, so no push had ever been sent and the daily job failed; secrets uploaded, both functions now start. E2E on a production build: 12/12. Re-run on the live site: 12/12.

sections.title: Maid's pay by days worked
sections.summary: Every flat now has a "Maid's pay" category that works like the cook's: daily rate × days worked (full days off unpaid, part days paid), split by days each person was home. Categories carry a staff role (cook or maid); pay counts everyone in that role employed that month. The rule label in Settings is now "Pay by days worked". E2E on a production build: 9/9. Re-run on the live site: 9/9.

sections.title: UI polish 1: shared pieces, navigation and Today
sections.summary: Kept the current look (Manrope, cream, teal) and tightened it. Today: your pending duty is now the one bold teal block at the top with a white Mark done button; once done it becomes a quiet row with Undo. Who's home shows an 'X of Y home' pill; the menu has divided rows with headcount pills and a 'This week' link; your share and 'Mark someone away' sit side by side as two tiles. Desktop (1024 px and wider) gets a left navigation rail with Settings, and Today splits into two columns; tablets get a wider column. Loading placeholders now match the shape of the page. Shared pieces added: SectionHeading, Pill, Skeleton, inverse button styles. Fixed: the keyboard focus ring could not be overridden (now white on the teal block). Checked locally at 375/768/1440 signed in as Madan: Mark done → Undo round trip, keyboard focus, no sideways scroll; typecheck, lint, 162/162 tests and a production build pass. Deployed with 4fb6a5c.

sections.title: Upload a bill photo or PDF (read only, not stored)
sections.summary: Scan a bill now has 'Take a photo' (camera) and 'Upload a photo or PDF' (gallery, files, screenshots, e-bills); desktop gets a drop zone. PDFs up to 4 MB go straight to Gemini; photos are still compressed first. At the user's request the bill is only read: nothing is uploaded to storage any more, and new scanned expenses have no bill picture (older ones keep theirs). Server checks the file's real content (JPEG or %PDF) and size; the page explains a too-large PDF or a wrong file type. Checked locally: a sample PDF and PNG bill each read correctly to the review step (~7 s and ~4 s), all 5 lines, total matches; nothing saved. Typecheck, lint, 162/162 tests pass. Deployed (4fb6a5c); re-run on the live site: PDF and PNG both read correctly (~7 s, ~5 s).

sections.title: Plan the whole week's menu on one screen
sections.summary: Menu has a 'Plan the week' button (menu owner, or the admin while none is set). One screen holds all 7 days × breakfast, lunch, dinner with one Save: cards on phones, a table on desktop, sticky save bar. 'Copy last week', 'Use usual menu' and 'Clear' fill the days still to come, with Undo; nothing is saved until Save week. Past days are read-only; a finished week says so. 'Save as our usual menu' stores the 7 days in a new menu_templates table (migration 20261115000001, pushed). Saving keeps each day's Order in / We'll cook choice. E2E on a production build with a throwaway flat: 38/38, no sideways scroll at 375/768/1440. Typecheck, lint, 162/162 tests pass. Deployed (a815730); re-run on the live site: 38/38.

sections.title: Edit all chores on one screen
sections.summary: Chores has an 'Edit chores' button that opens every chore on one screen: name, days (Daily + Mon–Sun chips: all seven is daily, one is weekly, otherwise some days), done-by time, and who takes turns (folded summary 'A → B → C', opens to reorder, remove or add people). Add a chore and delete (with Undo) on the same screen; an 'Edited'/'New' tag and a counter show what will change; one 'Save changes' saves them all. Every chore is checked before anything is written, so one bad chore saves nothing and is outlined with its own error. Each chore's Edit is now a labelled pencil button. Same rule as before: any flatmate can change chores. E2E on a production build with a throwaway flat: 38/38, no sideways scroll at 375/768/1440. Typecheck, lint, 162/162 tests pass. Deployed (a815730); re-run on the live site: 38/38.

sections.title: UI polish 2: Calendar and Chores
sections.summary: Calendar: on desktop the month grid sits beside the selected day; the day panel has an 'X of Y home' pill, a no-cook warning row, one row per away person ('Away all day' / 'Out: night', cook and maid labelled) that opens their away period, and the Mark someone away button; 'Who's away in <month>' has a count and divided rows. Chores: lighter cards in two columns on desktop; today's row shows who with a To do / Done pill (your own pending duty is outlined in teal); 'Who's next' is a 4-day strip with your days outlined; the away banner has an icon; rotation rows are divided with 'You' for yourself. Calendar and Chores have loading placeholders shaped like the page (their form pages keep the generic one). Checked on a production build with a seeded throwaway flat (3 flatmates, cook, maid, away periods, 3 chores): 38/38 including Mark done → Undo, keyboard day selection and empty states; Edit chores e2e still 38/38; no sideways scroll at 375/768/1440. Typecheck, lint, 162/162 tests pass. Deployed (70f1172); re-run on the live site: 38/38.

next_section.title: UI polish 3: Menu and Money
next_section.summary: Same polish on Menu (week list, day cards) and Money (ledger, expense detail, New split, scan): lighter rows, consistent headings, states and skeletons.

test_coverage.text: Locked shares exceed total → Save disabled, amount over shown
Away 14–15 Nov → absent those days, present 13 and 16
Next in rotation away → skips to next present member
Long-away member: out of groceries and gas, in rent and WiFi
Cook full-day leave on 7 Nov → unpaid
Cook partial-day leave → paid in full
Editing an away period after saving doesn't change shares
Out at night → dinner headcount −1; lunch, chores and splits unchanged

decisions.text: Design direction: the SPEC §6.1 mockup tokens (Manrope, #F5F4EF background, #0F6E64 accent, 16px cards, Lucide-style icons). design-taste-frontend is not installed, so this direction is kept for every later section.
Sign-in uses Tenant's own username and password accounts, not Supabase Auth.
Bill scanning runs on free tiers only: Gemini Flash first, Groq Llama 4 Scout as fallback.
Project log was set up by hand: the section-status-artifact and section-sync-check skills are not installed.
Part-day away: slots (morning/afternoon/night) for a single day; they only change meals. Chores and money treat the person as home. Breakfast added to the menu.

Sample data lives in the live flat (C2 102) because local and production share one Supabase project. Remove it with npm run seed:sample -- --remove (this also clears ALL chores, menu, away periods and expenses in that flat). Danielraj joined_on moved to 1 Aug 2026 so September bills include them.
Vercel functions run in sin1 (vercel.json) to sit next to Supabase ap-southeast-1. Sessions slide: 180 days, renewed by the proxy at most once a day.
Joining: flat code + admin approval (join_requests). The open invite link and join_flat/invite_preview were removed because they skipped approval.

Removing a member: with any history (bills, shares, duties, away days) they get left_on = yesterday (or their join day) and lose rotation, push and menu-owner; without history they are deleted. Re-joining reuses their old member row.
Moments that change flat membership (creating a flat, being accepted) use a full page load, so pages cached by the 60 s tab cache are not reused.

Own-data permissions: away days (own + cook/maid leave), splits (creator) and duties (person on duty); the admin can change anyone's. Chores themselves (add/edit/delete) are still open to every flatmate.
Mary replaces Lakshmi as cook from 6 Nov (Lakshmi left 5 Nov). Cook's pay adds up days worked across every cook employed in the month.

Usual skips are per person (breakfast/lunch/dinner), set by each person for themselves; only meal headcounts use them. Admin hand-over is one transaction: the new admin gains, the old one loses admin.
Maid's pay is cut for full days off, like the cook's (user's choice). expense_categories.staff_role says whose days a pay-by-days split counts.

UI improvement: the user chose to polish the current look (Manrope, cream, teal from SPEC §6.1) rather than a new direction. Plan: 1 shared components + nav + Today, 2 Calendar + Chores, 3 Menu + Money, 4 Settings, sign-in and onboarding.
Bills (photo or PDF) are read by the AI and not stored (user's choice). expenses.bill_image_path stays for older scanned expenses. PDFs: Gemini only, max 4 MB (Vercel's 4.5 MB request limit).

Week menu: one planner screen; Copy last week and Use usual menu overwrite only days from today on and can be undone before saving. The usual menu is one per flat (menu_templates, weekday 1–7), saved from the planner's checkbox. Chores and menu keep the current permission rules (user's choice).

Edit chores screen: days picked as chips, frequency derived (7 days = daily, 1 = weekly, else custom). Saving checks every chore first, then writes; the writes are separate statements, not one transaction.

open_questions: Should the ledger also show net 'who owes whom' balances (display only), or only each person's share per expense and per month?
Does the away flatmate pay maintenance or other fixed bills, or only rent and WiFi?
How should a member who leaves the flat for good settle up? Does the ledger need a 'settled' marker?
known_issues: No screenshots for Phases 1–5 or the sign-in change (built before this log existed).
No section's 'done when' criterion in SPEC §11 has been checked with real use yet (a week of chores, a month of money, 20 real bills).
§12 cases are covered by unit tests on the engine functions; there are no end-to-end UI tests.
The menu plan (Order in / We'll cook) is still one choice per day, even when the cook misses only one meal.
GROQ_API_KEY is not set in production or locally: bill scanning has no fallback if Gemini fails.
Bill scanning has not been tested on the production site. Push: functions now start (secrets uploaded 6 Nov) but no phone has subscribed yet, so delivery is untested.
Seven unused test domains (letscohabit, getcohabit, cohabithq, cohabito, cohabby, cohabiting, ourcohabit .vercel.app) are still attached to the Vercel project; remove them in Settings → Domains.
Sample logins use one shared sample password on the live site. Remove or change them before real use.
First tap on a tab still waits for one server trip (~0.35 s). Prefetching signed-in data would need "use cache: private" data caching; not done.
A visited tab can show data up to 60 s old when another flatmate changes something (your own saves refresh at once).
If you were signed out on your phone, likely causes were switching between tenant-plum.vercel.app and wecohabit.vercel.app (separate cookies) or the 30-day expiry. Not reproduced on desktop Chromium.

Deleting a whole flat that has chore duties fails in the database (the "skipped duty has no member" rule trips while members are removed). The app has no delete-flat feature; found while cleaning up test data.

The new error page (app/error.tsx) is in place but wasn't seen in a browser test: a dropped request already recovers through Next's full-page fallback, and a real server crash can't be injected into a production build.
With service workers blocked (some in-app/private browsers), the Serwist library logs "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'waiting')"; pages still work.

The daily chore job runs from pg_cron using two Vault values (supabase/.vault-setup.sql, run once in the Supabase SQL editor). Not verified that they exist; if not, the schedule still doesn't fire (pages create the day's duties when opened).
VAPID_SUBJECT is still the placeholder mailto:you@example.com.
UI polish is part-way: Menu, Money, Settings, sign-in and onboarding still have the old card-heavy layout (Today, Calendar and Chores are done).
Today's duties are created when a page first opens, so the very first load of the day can show 'Nothing for you today' until a refresh (seen while taking screenshots; existing behaviour).
PDF bills have no fallback reader: Groq only reads images (and GROQ_API_KEY isn't set). If Gemini fails, use a photo or New split.
New scanned expenses no longer keep a bill picture, so the expense page can't show the original bill for them.
Edit chores saves chore by chore: if the connection drops mid-save, some chores can be saved and others not (re-saving fixes it).
